title: Green Screen Pack
description: A Simple Resource Pack Designed to Facilitate Content Creation. This Pack turns Lime Wool into a Green Screen.
body:
# Green Screen Pack

A simple resource pack designed to make content creation in Minecraft easier.

Green Screen Pack turns the Lime Wool block into a fully functional green screen for recording and video editing. Examples of use include:

  • Creating cinematics and chroma key scenes.
  
  • Easily replacing backgrounds during video editing.
  
  • Making thumbnails and creative content.

In short, everything you can normally do with a green screen, but directly inside Minecraft.
